Sun & Moon series · GRI

Guardians Rising

Released May 5, 2017 · 180 cards

Expanded

Guardians Rising is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on May 5, 2017. Its main set has 145 cards, plus 35 secret rares numbered beyond the set (180 in total). It includes 148 Pokémon, 28 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

42 illustrators worked on Guardians Rising. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (49), Toyste Beach (11), Yoshinobu Saito (9), Kouki Saitou (8), Shin Nagasawa (8), Naoki Saito (7), Mitsuhiro Arita (5), TOKIYA (5).
